Thick_Cork_Bark_Plating.description: Incredibly thick, heavily fissured layers of dead cork cells forming a phenomenally effective biological armor. Specially evolved to survive raging forest fires, it is remarkably resistant to both slashing blades and open flame.

Photosynthetic_Leaf_Canopy.description: A dense covering of broad, brilliant green leaves. While offering absolutely no physical protection, they constantly harvest ambient sunlight, allowing the entity to slowly regenerate health directly from solar radiation.
